children: Nu Holdings Ltd. ("Nu" or the "Company") (NYSE: NU), one of the world's largest digital banking platforms, today announced that it will host its first Investor Day on Tuesday, December 8, 2026, in New York City, with both in-person and virtual attendance available.

The event will feature presentations by David Vélez, Founder and global Chief Executive Officer, and other members of Nu's senior management team, covering the Company's long-term strategy, growth opportunities, and drivers of value creation across its markets.
Registration details and the full agenda will be shared closer to the event. A live webcast and supporting materials will be available at investors.nu, with a replay posted following the event.
